findings.title: Reported attacks damaging water systems in conflict triple as children lose access to safe water
publication_date_displayed: 2026-11-05 (press release dateline, stating the report was released that day)
findings.event_period: Since October 2023, within retrospective assessment covering material through June 2026; no specific event date
findings.affected_population_system: Sewage pipelines and wastewater disposal; Gaza residents exposed to compromised sanitation infrastructure
findings.summary: A newly surfaced UNICEF Water Under Fire Volume 4 press release states more than 130,000 metres of sewage piping have been damaged in Gaza since October 2023 and untreated sewage has been discharged into the Mediterranean or temporary holding areas. This is retrospective infrastructure evidence, NOT damage newly occurring on November 5.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: In Gaza, since October 2023, more than 130,000 metres of sewage pipeline had been damaged
findings.source_type: Primary UN humanitarian agency press release, presenting a report-based assessment
findings.confidence: high for UNICEF's published statement; medium for whether the specific quantitative assessment is entirely new to all prior reporting
